content.bridge_context: Calculating the boundary and space covered by 2D shapes.

units.title: Perimeter vs Area
units.explanation: Perimeter is the distance around a closed figure. Area is the space occupied by it.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify perimeter in a picture of a fence. / बाड़ के चित्र में परिधि (perimeter) की पहचान करें।

units.title: Units of Measurement
units.explanation: Perimeter is in cm/m. Area is in square cm (cm²) or square m (m²).
units.dual_language_instruction: What is the unit of area for a classroom? / कक्षा के क्षेत्रफल की इकाई क्या है?
